mapper.sql: WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.business_group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{businessGroupName}, '%') AND LOWER(c.system_code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{systemCode}, '%')) AND s.responsible_team_name_snapshot LIKE CONCAT('%', #{responsibleTeam}, '%') AND (LOWER(s.short_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{systemKeyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(s.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{systemKeyword}, '%'))) AND c.total_check = #{totalCheck} AND (LOWER(c.system_code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(s.short_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(s.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))

FROM dm_component c JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = c.project_id AND p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s.code = c.system_code AND s.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON u1.id = c.created_by AND u1.tenant_id = c.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON u2.id = c.updated_by AND u2.tenant_id = c.tenant_id

c.project_id, p.project_code, p.project_name, c.system_code, c.enabled, s.business_group_name, s.short_name AS system_short_name, s.name AS system_name, s.description AS system_description, s.responsible_team_name_snapshot AS responsible_team_name, c.total_check, c.owner_id, c.created_at, u1.display_name AS created_by_name, c.updated_at, u2.display_name AS updated_by_name
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.system_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, c.system_code, c.enabled, s.business_group_name, s.short_name AS system_short_name, s.name AS system_name, s.description AS system_description, s.responsible_team_name_snapshot AS responsible_team_name, c.total_check, c.created_at, u1.display_name AS created_by_name, c.updated_at, u2.display_name AS updated_by_name ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.system_code

SELECT c.system_code AS value, CONCAT(c.system_code, ' - ', COALESCE(s.short_name, s.name, '')) AS label FROM dm_component c LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s.code = c.system_code AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.enabled = 1 ORDER BY c.system_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dm_component (tenant_id, project_id, system_code, enabled, total_check, owner_id, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{systemCode}, 1, #{totalCheck}, #{ownerId}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_component SET total_check = #{totalCheck}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_component SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode}
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.system_code = #{systemCode}
SELECT project_id, owner_id, enabled FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cnt), 0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_mapping_doc WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_dependency WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_script WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_topic WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_release_drill WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_report WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dm_parameter WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} AND deleted = 0) x
